description: Flat metadata schema for individual in vivo electrophysiology recording records from mouse cortex using multielectrode arrays, capturing LFP, spike trains, behavioral task context, and stimulus annotations.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual recording/session record.

experiment_id.descr: Identifier linking multiple records from the same experiment or study.

session_id.descr: Unique identifier for the recording session.

subject_id.descr: Unique identifier for the mouse subject.

species.descr: Biological species; expected value: Mus musculus.

strain.descr: Mouse strain or line, e.g., C57BL/6J, transgenic line name.

sex.descr: Sex of the mouse; typical values: male, female, unknown.

age_days.descr: Age of the mouse at recording time, in days.

weight_g.descr: Body weight at recording time, in grams.

genotype.descr: Genotype or transgene information for the mouse.

animal_protocol_id.descr: Institutional animal care and use protocol number or approval ID.

recording_start_time.descr: Start time of the recording session, if available.

recording_duration_s.descr: Total duration of the recording session in seconds.

brain_region.descr: Target brain region recorded, e.g., primary motor cortex, prefrontal cortex.

cortical_layer.descr: Cortical layer targeted or recorded from, if known.

anterior_posterior_mm.descr: Anatomical coordinate along the anterior-posterior axis in mm relative to reference.

medial_lateral_mm.descr: Anatomical coordinate along the medial-lateral axis in mm relative to reference.

dorsal_ventral_mm.descr: Anatomical coordinate along the dorsal-ventral axis in mm relative to reference.

coordinate_reference.descr: Reference atlas or stereotaxic origin used for coordinates, e.g., bregma.

electrode_array_type.descr: Type or model of multielectrode array used, e.g., silicon probe, tetrode array.

electrode_manufacturer.descr: Manufacturer or vendor of the electrode array.

num_channels_total.descr: Total number of recording channels available in the session.

num_channels_active.descr: Number of channels with usable signal during the session.

electrode_pitch_um.descr: Spacing between adjacent electrodes in micrometers.

electrode_impedance_kohm.descr: Typical electrode impedance in kilo-ohms at the measurement frequency, if available.

reference_scheme.descr: Reference method used for electrophysiological recording, e.g., common average, skull screw.

signal_types.descr: Recorded signal types present in the session; examples: LFP, spike trains.

lfp_recorded.descr: Whether local field potential data were recorded.

spike_trains_recorded.descr: Whether spike train data were recorded.

sampling_rate_hz.descr: Primary acquisition sampling rate in Hz.

lfp_sampling_rate_hz.descr: Sampling rate of the LFP stream in Hz, if downsampled separately.

spike_detection_threshold.descr: Threshold used for spike detection, in signal units or z-score as specified in spike_detection_method.

spike_detection_method.descr: Method used to detect spikes, e.g., threshold crossing, template matching.

spike_sorting_software.descr: Software used for spike sorting, if applicable.

spike_sorting_version.descr: Version of the spike sorting software.

spike_sorting_quality_metric.descr: Primary metric used to assess spike sorting quality, e.g., isolation distance, SNR.

preprocessing_pipeline.descr: Description or name of preprocessing steps applied to raw data, e.g., filtering, notch removal, artifact rejection.

bandpass_filter_low_hz.descr: Lower cutoff frequency of bandpass filter in Hz, if used.

bandpass_filter_high_hz.descr: Upper cutoff frequency of bandpass filter in Hz, if used.

notch_filter_hz.descr: Notch filter frequency in Hz, if used to remove line noise.

artifact_rejection_applied.descr: Whether artifact rejection was applied to the data.

behavioral_task_name.descr: Name of the behavioral task performed during recording, e.g., decision-making task.

behavioral_task_type.descr: High-level task category, e.g., go/no-go, two-alternative forced choice.

behavioral_state.descr: Behavioral or arousal state during recording, e.g., awake, anesthetized, engaged, resting.

trial_count.descr: Number of trials included in the recording session.

trial_structure_description.descr: Brief description of trial timing and structure.

stimulus_type.descr: Type of stimulus presented, e.g., visual, auditory, tactile, none.

stimulus_parameters.descr: Stimulus parameter summary, such as intensity, frequency, duration, contrast, or other relevant settings.

stimulus_onset_times_s.descr: Timing of stimulus onsets relative to recording start, in seconds.

behavioral_annotations.descr: Summary of behavioral annotations captured, such as choice, reaction time, reward, error, or licking.

decision_variable.descr: Behavioral decision variable or outcome measure, if defined.

outcome_label.descr: Outcome label for the trial or session, e.g., correct, incorrect, miss, hit.

sync_method.descr: Method used to synchronize electrophysiology, stimulus, and behavior time bases.

timestamp_units.descr: Units used for time stamps in the record, e.g., seconds, milliseconds, samples.

file_name_raw.descr: Name of the raw data file associated with this recording record.

file_format_raw.descr: Format of the raw electrophysiology data file, e.g., NWB, BIN, EDF, MAT.

file_name_processed.descr: Name of the processed data file, if available.

file_format_processed.descr: Format of the processed data file, if available.

data_repository.descr: Repository or database where the record is stored, if applicable.

accession_number.descr: Accession number or persistent identifier for the record, if available.

processing_date.descr: Date when preprocessing or analysis for this record was performed.

analysis_software.descr: Software used for analysis of this record.

notes.descr: Free-text notes relevant to this specific recording record.
